title: Run the gold labeling annotation pass
description:
Per The Way: one annotation names a labeling pass over the fixture message corpus — every fixture human message gets a gold label (thanks, fbomb, both, neither, excluded); contested labels are filed as findings (one gold label each, staying proposed until a person accepts). Record the pass in annotations/<id>/pass.md per repo convention.

Done when: every fixture message carries a gold label; the annotation pass is recorded; contested labels exist as proposed findings.

comments.author: ubuntu
comments.text: Done. annotations/KDATAP-da54f5/gold-labels.yaml: 7 gold-labeled fixture human messages (4 thanks, 1 both, 1 fbomb, 1 neither) across claude-code, cursor-agent, codex. gold-eval.spec.ts runs the real adapters over the fixture corpus and asserts exact bidirectional match (100% on the synthetic corpus). Note: cursor fixture moved under cursor-home/projects/<sanitized>/agent-transcripts/<sid>/ to match adapter discovery. Real-corpus evaluation is KDATAP-713a0f.
